name: Layer3 USD live spot collateral valuation
summary: Loan.supply valued deposited collateral with PancakeSwap Router getAmountsOut, a live spot quote, and minted LUSD from it. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, pumped BTCB in the BTCB/USDT pair, supplied a little BTCB for inflated LUSD, and redeemed that LUSD for USDT at LUSDPool.withdraw.
notes: The exploit needed Loan's BTCB listing (setInfo, block 29033499) and LUSD's MANAGER_ROLE grant to Loan, which lets Loan mint; the grant came 48 blocks later and is the latest of the two, so it sets the age.

The 100 USDT LUSDPool.withdraw paired with L3 into the L3/USDT pair stayed in the pool's own LP position, so the pool and that pair are netted as victims. The BTCB collateral the attacker left in Loan is not subtracted (rule 11).
